RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel often reflects senior engineering demographics, but it significantly elevates the risk of affinity bias—especially when subjective factors like "client relationships" override substantial differences in experience. However, the panel's gender composition alone does not prove unlawful discrimination. 

Do not raise sex bias immediately. Instead, follow up firmly on your requested written feedback to see their documented scoring criteria and rationale. If their explanation reveals inconsistencies or fails to materialize, consult an employment lawyer or professional association before deciding whether to raise bias formally. Accusing the panel directly without legal advice or documentary evidence risks damaging professional relationships without improving your outcome.
